cases.name: 0101_日期矩阵_DAY_color_map
cases.expression:
VAR VALUE_DAY = [0001_销售金额_单位_D_]
VAR VALUE_TABLE_0 =
    CALCULATETABLE (
        '01_Calendar',
        ALL (
            '01_Calendar'[dates],
            '01_Calendar'[day],
            '01_Calendar'[weeknumber],
            '01_Calendar'[weekday],
            '01_Calendar'[weekcna] //易错点：注意清除筛选的时候，按列排序的列都要加上；weekcna按照weekday排序的。
        )
    )
VAR VALUE_TABLE_1 =
    SUMMARIZE (
        VALUE_TABLE_0,
        '01_Calendar'[day],
        "@DAY", [0001_销售金额_单位_D_]
    )
VAR VALUE_DAY_MAX =
    MAXX ( VALUE_TABLE_1, [@DAY] )
VAR VALUE_DAY_MIN =
    MINX ( VALUE_TABLE_1, [@DAY] )
VAR VALUE_DIFF_MAX = ( VALUE_DAY_MAX - VALUE_DAY_MIN ) //min是最浅颜色，max是最深颜色。
VAR VALUE_DIFF_DAY = ( VALUE_DAY_MAX - VALUE_DAY )
VAR X = VALUE_DIFF_DAY / VALUE_DIFF_MAX
VAR R =
    INT ( 200 * X ) + 20
VAR G =
    INT ( 100 * X ) + 140 //222,239
VAR B = 250
VAR D = ","
VAR TF =
    VALUE_DAY = BLANK ()
RETURN
    IF ( TF, "#dddddd", "RGB(" & R & D & G & D & B & ")" )

cases.name: 0200_计算组矩阵_color_背景
cases.expression:
/*
    good:#188818
    neutral:#DD8800
    bad:#BB1818
    1、YTD>=1,MTD>=1 =>good
    2、YTD>=1,MTD< 1 =>neutral
    3、YTD< 1,MTD>=1 =>neutral
    4、YTD< 1,MTD< 1=>bad
*/
VAR MTD0 =
    VAR DATE_END_AC =
        LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[dates] )
    VAR DATE_SATRT_AC =
        STARTOFMONTH ( DATE_END_AC )
    VAR DATE_TABLE_AC =
        DATESBETWEEN ( '01_Calendar'[dates], DATE_SATRT_AC, DATE_END_AC )
    RETURN
        CALCULATE ( [0007_目标完成率_%_D_], DATE_TABLE_AC )
VAR YTD0 =
    VAR DATE_END_AC =
        LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[dates] )
    VAR DATE_SATRT_AC =
        STARTOFYEAR ( DATE_END_AC )
    VAR DATE_TABLE_AC =
        DATESBETWEEN ( '01_Calendar'[dates], DATE_SATRT_AC, DATE_END_AC )
    RETURN
        CALCULATE ( [0007_目标完成率_%_D_], DATE_TABLE_AC )
VAR COLOR0 =
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        YTD0 >= 1
            && MTD0 >= 1, "#188818",
        YTD0 >= 1
            && MTD0 < 1, "#DD8800",
        YTD0 < 1
            && MTD0 >= 1, "#DD8800",
        YTD0 < 1
            && MTD0 < 1, "#BB1818"
    )
VAR LIST0 = { "AC", "MTD", "YTD" }
VAR ROW_VALUE =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'G03_P60_DWMQHY'[F_07_指标] )
VAR COLOR_AC_TF =
    IF ( ROW_VALUE IN LIST0, COLOR0, BLANK () )
RETURN
    COLOR_AC_TF

cases.expression:
/*

    neutral:#DD8800 ; RGB:221,136,0
    bad:#BB1818 ; RGB:187,24,24；色阶开始：#FFCCCC , RGB:255,204,204
    字体颜色：#EEEEEE ; RGB:238,238,238
*/
VAR ROW0 =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'T74_ROW'[ROW] ) - 1
VAR COLUMN0 =
    SELECTEDVALUE ( T75_COLUMN[COLUMN] )
VAR RANK0 = ROW0 * 10 + COLUMN0

        ALL ( 'T01_门店表'[F_02_门店名称] ),
        "@VALUE0", [0001_销售金额_单位_D_]
    )

VAR T2 =
    ADDCOLUMNS (

            RANKX ( T1, [0001_销售金额_单位_D_],, DESC )
                + CALCULATE ( SUM ( 'T01_门店表'[F_00_自动编号] ) ) / 1000
    )
VAR T3 =
    ADDCOLUMNS ( T2, "@R1", VAR R = [@R0] RETURN RANKX ( T2, [@R0], R, ASC ) )
VAR T4 =
    FILTER ( T3, [@R1] = RANK0 )
VAR MD =
    MAXX ( T4, [F_02_门店名称] )
VAR FILTER0 =
    TREATAS ( { MD }, 'T01_门店表'[F_02_门店名称] )
VAR VALUE_MD =
    CALCULATE ( [0006_毛利率_%_D_], KEEPFILTERS ( FILTER0 ) )
VAR VALUE_TABLE_0 =
    CALCULATETABLE ( 'T01_门店表', ALL ( 'T01_门店表'[F_01_门店编号], 'T01_门店表'[F_02_门店名称] ) )
VAR VALUE_TABLE_1 =
    SUMMARIZE (
        VALUE_TABLE_0,
        'T01_门店表'[F_02_门店名称],
        "@ML", [0006_毛利率_%_D_]
    )
VAR VALUE_MD_MAX =
    MAXX ( VALUE_TABLE_1, [@ML] )
VAR VALUE_MD_0 = 0
VAR VALUE_MD_MIN =
    MINX ( VALUE_TABLE_1, [@ML] )
VAR VALUE_DIFF_MAX_0 = ( VALUE_MD_MAX - VALUE_MD_0 ) //0是最浅颜色，max是最深good颜色。
VAR VALUE_DIFF_MIN_0 = ( VALUE_MD_MIN - VALUE_MD_0 ) //0是最浅颜色，MIN是最深bad颜色；0包含在bad中。
VAR VALUE_DIFF_MD_POSITIVE = ( VALUE_MD_MAX - VALUE_MD ) //正数=>positive
VAR VALUE_DIFF_MD_NEGATIVE = ( VALUE_MD_MIN - VALUE_MD ) //负数=>negative
VAR X =
    IF (
        VALUE_MD > 0,
        VALUE_DIFF_MD_POSITIVE / VALUE_DIFF_MAX_0,
        VALUE_DIFF_MD_NEGATIVE / VALUE_DIFF_MIN_0
    ) --------------------------------
//good:#188818 ; RGB:24,136,24 ; 色阶开始：#CCFFCC , RGB:204,255,204
VAR R_GOOD =
    INT ( 180 * X ) + 24 //204-24=180
VAR G_GOOD =
    INT ( 119 * X ) + 136 //255-136=119
VAR B_GOOD =
    INT ( 180 * X ) + 24 //204-24=180
--------------------------------
--------------------------------
//bad:#BB1818 ; RGB:187,24,24；色阶开始：#FFCCCC , RGB:255,204,204
VAR R_BAD =
    INT ( 68 * X ) + 187 //255-187=68
VAR G_BAD =
    INT ( 180 * X ) + 24 //204-24=180
VAR B_BAD =
    INT ( 180 * X ) + 24 //204-24=180
--------------------------------
VAR R =
    IF ( VALUE_MD > 0, R_GOOD, R_BAD )
VAR G =
    IF ( VALUE_MD > 0, G_GOOD, G_BAD )
VAR B =
    IF ( VALUE_MD > 0, B_GOOD, B_BAD )
VAR D = ","
VAR TF =
    VALUE_MD = BLANK ()
RETURN
    IF ( TF, "#dddddd", "RGB(" & R & D & G & D & B & ")" )

cases.name: 0800_产品数量_库存_期初_单位_
cases.expression:
VAR DATE_START0 =
    CALCULATE ( FIRSTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[dates] ), ALL ( '01_Calendar' ) )
VAR DATE_END0 =
    LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[dates] )
VAR TF0 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[dates] ) //日
VAR TF1 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[YW] ) //周
VAR TF2 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[YM] ) //月
VAR TF3 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[YQ] ) //季度
VAR TF4 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[YH] ) //半年度
VAR TF5 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[FY00] ) //年度
VAR N0 =
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        TF0, 0,
        TF1,
            DATEDIFF (
                FIRSTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[StartOfWeek] ),
                LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfWeek] ),
                DAY
            ),
        TF2,
            DATEDIFF (
                FIRSTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[StartOfMonth] ),
                LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfMonth] ),
                DAY
            ),
        TF3,
            DATEDIFF (
                FIRSTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[StartOfQuarter] ),
                LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfQuarter] ),
                DAY
            ),
        TF4,
            DATEDIFF (
                FIRSTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[StartOfHalfYear] ),
                LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfHalfYear] ),
                DAY
            ),
        TF5,
            DATEDIFF (
                FIRSTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[StartOfYear] ),
                LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfYear] ),
                DAY
            ),
        0
    ) + 1
VAR DATE_END1 =
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        TF0, DATEADD ( DATE_END0, - N0, DAY ),
        TF1, DATEADD ( LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfWeek] ), - N0, DAY ),
        TF2, DATEADD ( LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfMonth] ), - N0, DAY ),
        TF3, DATEADD ( LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfQuarter] ), - N0, DAY ),
        TF4, DATEADD ( LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfHalfYear] ), - N0, DAY ),
        TF5, DATEADD ( LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[EndOfYear] ), - N0, DAY ),
        DATE_START0 //无筛选的时，默认日期表期初。
    )
VAR DATE_END2 =
    IF ( ISBLANK ( DATE_END1 ), DATE_START0, DATE_END1 ) //兼容dateadd后的空值，注意日期表的两个端点。
VAR DATE_TABLE0 =
    DATESBETWEEN ( '01_Calendar'[dates], DATE_START0, DATE_END2 )
VAR IN0 =
    CALCULATE ( [0018_产品数量_入库_单位_D_], DATE_TABLE0 )
VAR OUT0 =
    CALCULATE ( [0019_产品数量_出库_单位_D_], DATE_TABLE0 )
VAR DATE_START_ABS0 =
    CALCULATE ( LASTDATE ( 'T04_订单主表'[F_04_送货日期] ), ALL () ) //兼容显示到事实表最后日期。
RETURN
    IN0 - OUT0
//IF ( DATE_START_ABS0 >= DATE_END2, IN0 - OUT0, BLANK () )

cases.name: 0802_产品数量_库存_期间平均库存_单位_
0803_产品数量_库存_期间周转率_单位_
0804_产品数量_库存_期间周转天数_单位_
cases.expression:
/*
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
存货周转天数（Days Sales Of Inventory），参考值=>年度：120;半年：60;季度：30;月度：9;周度：2;单日：1。
存货周转率（Inventory Turnover），越大表示周转越快。
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
年度：N = 360
半年：N = 180
季度：N = 90
月度：N = 30
周度：N = 7
单日: N = 1
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
库存周转天数 = N / 期间存货周转率
库存周转率 = 期间出库数量 / 期间平均库存 
期间平均库存 =（ 期初库存 + 期末库存）÷ 2
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*/
VAR TF0 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[dates] ) //日
VAR TF1 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[YW] ) //周
VAR TF2 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[YM] ) //月
VAR TF3 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[YQ] ) //季度
VAR TF4 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[YH] ) //半年度
VAR TF5 =
    HASONEVALUE ( '01_Calendar'[FY00] ) //年度
VAR N =
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        TF0, 1,
        TF1, 7,
        TF2, 30,
        TF3, 90,
        TF4, 180,
        TF5, 360,
        COUNTROWS ( '01_Calendar' )
    )
VAR DaysSalesOfInventory =
    DIVIDE ( N, [0803_产品数量_库存_期间周转率_单位_] )
RETURN
    DaysSalesOfInventory

cases.name: 1500_预测_预测达成_单位_

VAR DAY_MAX =
    CALCULATETABLE ( LASTDATE ( 'T04_订单主表'[F_03_下单日期] ), ALL ( '01_Calendar' ) )
VAR DAY_MIN =
    CALCULATETABLE (
        STARTOFYEAR ( '01_Calendar'[dates] ),
        ALLSELECTED ( '01_Calendar' )
    )
VAR DATE_AC =
    DATESBETWEEN ( '01_Calendar'[dates], DAY_MIN, DAY_MAX )
VAR DATE_PRE =
    DATESBETWEEN (
        '01_Calendar'[dates],
        DATEADD ( DAY_MIN, -1, YEAR ),
        DATEADD ( DAY_MAX, -1, YEAR )
    )
VAR YTD_AC =
    CALCULATE ( [0001_销售金额_单位_D_], DATE_AC )
VAR YTD_PRE =
    CALCULATE ( [0001_销售金额_单位_D_], DATE_PRE )
VAR YOY =
    DIVIDE ( YTD_AC, YTD_PRE )
VAR DAY_AC =
    MAX ( '01_Calendar'[dates] )
VAR PRE =
    CALCULATE (
        [0001_销售金额_单位_D_],
        DATEADD ( '01_Calendar'[dates], -1, YEAR )
    )
RETURN
    IF ( DAY_AC <= DAY_MAX, BLANK (), PRE * YOY )

cases.name: 1503_预测_预测达成_MTD_单位_
cases.expression:
VAR DAY_MAX0 =
    CALCULATETABLE ( LASTDATE ( 'T04_订单主表'[F_03_下单日期] ), ALL ( '01_Calendar' ) )
VAR DAY_MAX1 =
    CALCULATETABLE (
        LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[dates] ),
        TREATAS ( DAY_MAX0, '01_Calendar'[dates] )
    ) //由于'T04_订单主表'[F_03_下单日期]最大日期后在无日期，DATEADD后为空，需要转化到'01_Calendar'[dates]
VAR DAY_MAX2 =
    DATEADD ( DAY_MAX1, 1, DAY )
VAR DAY_MIN =
    CALCULATETABLE (
        STARTOFMONTH ( '01_Calendar'[dates] ),
        ALLSELECTED ( '01_Calendar' )
    )
VAR DAY_AC =
    LASTDATE ( '01_Calendar'[dates] )
VAR MTD_FORE0 =
    CALCULATE (
        [1500_预测_预测达成_单位_],
        DATESBETWEEN ( '01_Calendar'[dates], DAY_MAX2, DAY_AC )
    )
VAR MTD_FORE1 =
    CALCULATE (
        [1500_预测_预测达成_单位_],
        DATESMTD ( '01_Calendar'[dates] )
    )
VAR MTD_AC =
    CALCULATE ( [0001_销售金额_单位_D_], DATESMTD ( '01_Calendar'[dates] ) )
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        DAY_AC >= DAY_MAX0
            && DAY_MIN > DAY_MAX0, MTD_FORE1,
        DAY_AC >= DAY_MAX0
            && DAY_MIN <= DAY_MAX0, MTD_AC + MTD_FORE0,
        BLANK ()
    )

cases.name: 安全库存
cases.expression:
/*
说明：因理想为标准正太分布，安全库存仅作为参考点，需要加入业务的理解。
SS= z * SQRT( σd^2* μL + σL^2 * μd^2 )
其中
SS：安全库存（Safe Stock）
z : 服务水平系数，服务水平（现货率）为0.95，在标准正太分布下对应的z=1.65。
L : 采购提前期
μL: 平均提前期
σL: 提前期L的标准差
d : 日出库量
μd: 平均日出库量
σd: 日出库量d的标准差
*/
1

cases.name: logo_image2
cases.expression:
VAR SvgStartImage =
    "data:image/svg+xml;utf8,"

VAR ConfigTable =
    FILTER (
        'PbiUtilsTemplateMeasures',
        'PbiUtilsTemplateMeasures'[name] = "logo_image2"
    )

VAR ConfigValue =
    CONCATENATEX (
        ConfigTable,
        'PbiUtilsTemplateMeasures'[value]
    )

VAR SvgMatchPosition =
    COALESCE (
        SEARCH (
            "<svg*</svg>",
            ConfigValue,
            1,
            BLANK ()
        ),
        SEARCH (
            "<svg*/>",
            ConfigValue,
            1,
            BLANK ()
        )
    )

VAR Result =
    IF (
        ISBLANK ( SvgMatchPosition )
            || LEFT (
                ConfigValue,
                5
            )
            = "data:"
            || LEFT (
                ConfigValue,
                7
            )
            = "http://"
            || LEFT (
                ConfigValue,
                8
            )
            = "https://",
        ConfigValue,
        SvgStartImage & ConfigValue
    )

RETURN
    Result
